definitions.full: H8179. shaar שַׁ֫עַר 373 noun masculine 2Sam 18:24 ( feminine Isa 14:31 in personification, Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 86 ) gate ; — ׳שׁ absolute Judg 9:40 +, construct Gen 22:17 +; with ה locative, שָׁ֑עְרָה Isa 28:6 +; plural שְׁעָרִים 2Sam 18:24 +, construct שַׁעֲרֵי 1Sam 17:52 +; suffix שְׁעָרֶיךָ Deut 12:15 +, שַׁעֲרֵיהֶם Ezek 21:20 ; 48:34 , etc.; — 1. a. gate , entrance to city, shut ( סָגַר ) by night Josh 2:5 , 7 (JE), compare Isa 45:1 , opened ( מָּתַח ) by day Neh 7:3 , compare Isa 60:11 ; for entrance ( בּוֺא ), and exit ( יָצָא ) Jer 17:19-20 , 21 , 24 , 25 , 27 ; Lam 4:12 ; Ezek 26:10 +; שׁ ׳עָבַר Micah 2:13 pass out through (disregard accents), ׳ע ׳בַּשׁ Isa 62:10 ; with bars Psa 147:13 ; attacked Ezek 21:20 ; 21:27 , compare Isa 28:6 ; Micah 1:9 , 12 ; 1Sam 17:52 ; on Judg 5:8 , 11 see Commentaries; burned (by foe) Jeremiah 19:27; Jer 51:58 ; Neh 1:3 ; 2:3 , 13 , 17 ; as giving control, possession, of city, שׁ אֵת ׳יָרַשׁ אֹיְבָיו Gen 22:17 ; 24:60 (J); הַשּׁ ׳מֶּתַח Judg 9:40 + (see ׳פ ), הַשּׁ ׳דַּלְתוֺת 1Sam 21:14 + (see ׳ד 3 ); ׳מֶּתַחהַֿשּׁ Judg 18:16-17 , of farm or village; so of camp Exod 32:26-27 , (J). In cities, elaborate structure, with roof 2Sam 18:24 , upper chamber 19:1 ; compare רָאשֵׁיכֶם שְׁעָרִים שְׂאוּ Psa 24:7 ; 24:9 ; write laws ׳בִּשׁ Deut 6:9 ( + בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ עַלמְֿזֻזוֺת ), 11:20 (+ id. .); הַשּׁ ׳בְּתוֺךְ 1Sam 9:18 , הַשּׁ ׳אֶלאתּוֺךְ 2Sam 3:27 ; שׁ ׳(לְ)יַד as public, 1Sam 4:18 , + 4:13 ᵐ5 Th We Dr and others, compare 2Sam 15:2 ; 18:4 ; Prov 8:3 (|| פְתָחִים מְבוֺא ). b. particular gates of Jerusalem are: -1 ׳שׁ אֶפְרַיִם 3b ); (16) ׳שׁ הַמִּנָּה 2Kin 14:13 || 2Chr 25:23 (read הַמִּנָּה for הַמּוֺנֶה ), Jer 31:38 ; 2Chr 26:9 ; probably = ׳שׁ הַמִּנִּים Zech 14:10 ; -17 ׳שׁ הַצּאֹן Neh 3:1 , 32 ; 12:39 ; -18 ׳שׁ הָרִאשׁוֺן Zech 14:10 ; — on sites and related to each other see RS-GASm Ency.
